scope.mode: final plan-only closure audit after round-6 combined repairs
scope.specialty: Improvement tuple reducer and event interleavings; rollback plus cancellation exact cases; single cleanup ownership; exact-one canary child/link; widening and promotion UNKNOWN handling; unconditional evidence completeness denial; asynchronous child and terminal paths.
scope.severity_rule: Critical/high only for an unmet user requirement, contradiction, unsafe or undefined implementation path, or material evidence overclaim. Implementation, a full reachable-product model, and completion of fresh evidence retrieval or semantic review are not required.

contract_reproduction.basis: IRB07-N/R/Q now partition VERIFIED->ROLLED_BACK by NONE, REQUESTED, and QUIESCING and reproduce the declared canonical sequences. IRB08 is limited to NONE, while IX03 is the sole cancellation cleanup scheduler for REQUESTED/QUIESCING after rollback is IDLE or ROLLED_BACK. The FAILED plus no-retry/exhausted case remains non-settleable as R7-INT-001 details.

For the repaired settlement cases, IRB08 alone schedules ordinary post-rollback cleanup and IX03 alone schedules cancellation cleanup; both require a later cleanup receipt and later terminal transaction. IX05 adopts already-existing cleanup without creating a second manifest.

IR04 now derives deterministic child/link IDs from parent, stage, and CanaryAdmissionDecision digest, and same-decision replay uses atomic absent-or-same CAS. IR27-IR35 bind receipts to that pair. Decision replacement can nevertheless admit a new pair before the prior pair is terminal and clean, as R7-INT-002 details.

UNKNOWN entry and the reconstructed-success/proved-absence witnesses reproduce. The direct verified widening path is not consumable by IR38, and the generic exhaustive UNKNOWN dispositions do not have synchronized rollout exits, as R7-INT-003 and R7-INT-004 detail.
PLAN §8.4 forbids canary resume while control is degraded or failed, but IR06 omits a HEALTHY guard and the reducer merely masks the changed rollout coordinate as BLOCKED. See R7-INT-005.

PLAN §8.5 now requires duplicate-free expected/received tuple-set equality, exact per-class and total counts, digest validation, and 100% passing executable cases. Missing, duplicate, unexpected, failed, inconclusive, or unaccounted tuples always deny enablement, canary admission, widening, and promotion. A protected disposition can only DENY, ABORT, QUARANTINE, or RERUN under a newly sealed manifest; exclusions are predeclared outside the executable expected set.

SHA-256 reproduces for PLAN.md (e0a3194743e4434fa7f40212ef81c29985b8f63db7e9b24ae62b199c0ed4ed70) and the normative manifest (9c54a76d8090485d1a3e84283b4fbf9bda5cf481f4ee887a5ca7d2b46090476a). Its legacy relations remain candidate_support/candidate_refute/context_only with zero supports/refutes, and reader-facing legacy prose is marked non-authoritative. No implementation, fresh retrieval, or semantic-review completion is claimed.

findings.title: Cancellation cannot settle when rollback has a final no-retry failure
findings.requirement: Whole-work cancellation is accepted from every reachable nonterminal improvement tuple and must have a deterministic safe outcome after effect, rollback, quiescence, and cleanup handling; every nonterminal state must have a total outcome partition or bounded expiry exit.
evidence: IRB04 reaches rollback_state=FAILED for failed, unknown, or timed-out verification.
IRB06 handles retry forbidden, stale, or exhausted only as FAILED->FAILED, records a final rollback-failure disposition, and schedules safety escalation.
IRB05 is the only edge out of FAILED and requires an approved retry, fresh authority, and budget.

IX03 expressly forbids rollback_state=FAILED, while the exact witness says cancellation at FAILED must take IRB05 and later verification before IX03. No row handles the case where IRB06 proves that such a retry is forbidden or exhausted.
reproduction: Reach rollback VERIFYING after exposure, apply IX01 and IX02, then let IRB04 set rollback_state=FAILED.
Make retry forbidden or exhausted and apply IRB06. The tuple remains rollback FAILED and canonically ROLLBACK_FAILED under priority 2.
IRB05 is disabled and IX03 is forbidden. Replaying IRB06 cannot settle rollback, schedule cancellation cleanup, or reach CANCELLED.
findings.impact: A valid cancellation can be stranded permanently after a declared final rollback failure. The contract promises acceptance and bounded recovery but supplies neither a terminal failed-safety carrier nor an explicit retained-risk cancellation disposition, leaving the implementation path undefined.
findings.required_plan_correction: Add one explicit fail-closed outcome for final rollback failure during cancellation. It must preserve visible unresolved exposure/risk, define whether the parent remains nonterminal or hands off to a protected remediation obligation, and give exact reducer projection, cleanup ownership, and terminal eligibility. Do not treat failed rollback as ROLLED_BACK or clean.

findings.title: Replacing a stale canary decision can create a second child/link pair before the first pair is terminal and clean
findings.requirement: The bounded canary contract requires one causally bound child/link whose execution, cancellation, effects, rollback, cleanup, and receipts cannot overlap or be masked by a replacement child.
evidence: IR04 leaves the parent at CANARY_READY after creating the deterministic pair.

IR24 can then take CANARY_READY->CANARY_PENDING_APPROVAL on expiry, withdrawal, or stale input and says only 'cancel unstarted child if created'; it does not require a durable child terminal, effect settlement, rollback settlement, or cleanup receipt before the parent can accept another decision.
A new CanaryAdmissionDecision changes the deterministic IR04 identity. IR03 and IR04 can therefore create a second, non-duplicate pair while the first child is still cancelling or cleaning.

Section 15.7 says all predicates use 'the same identity' and no duplicate-child join exists, but it defines no active-pair replacement transaction or join over two decision-derived historical/live pairs.
reproduction: Create C1/L1 with IR04 and keep the parent CANARY_READY while C1 cancellation/cleanup is not terminal.
Apply IR24 for stale input, accept a new decision with IR03, and apply IR04 again. The new decision digest derives C2/L2, so absent-or-same uniqueness for C1 does not reject it.
The tuple now has C1 still live in cancellation/cleanup and C2 admitted at INBOX, but later singular receipt and terminal predicates do not define an atomic handoff or a join over both pairs.
findings.impact: Old child authority, effects, or cleanup can overlap a replacement canary or be omitted from the singular parent outcome. This defeats the exact-one safety bound despite fixing same-decision replay.
findings.required_plan_correction: Make decision replacement wait for the prior bound pair to be terminal, quiescent, effect/rollback-settled, and clean before IR03/IR04 can create a new pair, or model an explicit active-pair generation coordinate and require all old generations in every safety and terminal predicate. Cover delayed/out-of-order WorkerStarted and terminal receipts.

findings.title: A directly verified widening effect has no legal rollout-success edge
findings.requirement: A WideningDecision must have a total effect path: direct verified application and reconstructed verified application must each permit the same bounded CANARY_RUNNING continuation, while UNKNOWN or failure must never be treated as success.
evidence: IR37 creates a typed widening effect in WIDENING_EFFECT.
The general Effect machine permits the normal E01->E04->E05->E06 path to RECEIPT_VERIFIED without UNKNOWN reconciliation.
IR38 requires an 'already-durable IR56 verified widening effect receipt'. IR56 is only the synchronized E17 APPLICATION_RECONCILED->RECEIPT_VERIFIED path after UNKNOWN.
No other row takes WIDENING_EFFECT->CANARY_RUNNING after an ordinary E06 receipt.
reproduction: Apply IR37, then execute the widening effect normally through E01, E04, E05, and E06 with a valid remote receipt.
The effect set is settled and the reducer returns canonical REVIEW for rollout WIDENING_EFFECT.
IR56 is inapplicable because the effect is already RECEIPT_VERIFIED rather than APPLICATION_RECONCILED, and IR38's exact guard names IR56. The successful widening cannot resume canary.
findings.impact: The ordinary successful path is undefined/stuck; only a success reconstructed after ambiguity can advance. Implementations must weaken IR38, forge an IR56 history, or diverge from the closed manifest.
findings.required_plan_correction: Let IR38 consume either a directly verified E06 receipt or the exact reconstructed IR56/E17 receipt, with the same decision/bounds/identity bindings, or add separate mutually exclusive synchronized rows and witnesses for both paths.

findings.title: Widening and promotion lack rollout exits for exhaustive UNKNOWN dispositions other than reconstructed success or proved absence
findings.requirement: Because the Effect aggregate declares exhaustive UNKNOWN reconciliation and disposition paths, every reachable terminal effect disposition must have a fail-closed synchronized rollout outcome. ACCEPTED_RISK, DECLARE_FAILED, compensation success/failure, and unresolved reconstructed-receipt failure cannot authorize widening/promotion or strand the rollout.
evidence: After IR42 or IR54, E12/E18/E19 can reach QUARANTINED, where E20, E21, or E22 are exhaustive legal dispositions; E22 can finish as COMPENSATED or COMPENSATION_FAILED, and E36 can also lead back through UNRESOLVED/QUARANTINED.

For widening, IR56 handles only E17 reconstructed receipt success and IR43 handles only E34 proved absence/no retry. No row synchronizes E20/E21/E24/E25/E28/E29/E37/E39 terminal outcomes with WIDENING_EFFECT->CANARY_ABORTING or FAILED.
For promotion, IR57 handles only E17 and IR55 only E34. No row moves PROMOTING to a fail-closed rollout state for the other declared terminal dispositions.

The reducer stops showing QUARANTINED once the effect becomes settled, but maps WIDENING_EFFECT back to REVIEW and PROMOTING back to MERGE_QUEUED; that projection is not a legal recovery edge and does not itself change the rollout coordinate.
reproduction: Enter widening UNKNOWN with IR42, take E12, E18, E19, then DECLARE_FAILED through E21. The effect is SETTLED_FAILURE but rollout remains WIDENING_EFFECT; neither IR43 nor IR56 applies.
Repeat from promotion UNKNOWN via IR54 and end with E20 ACCEPTED_RISK or an authorized compensation that reaches E24. Rollout remains PROMOTING; IR18, IR55, and IR57 do not apply.
In each case the generic Effect machine reached a declared terminal, but the product has no synchronized abort/failure/cleanup owner.
findings.impact: Ambiguous production mutations can leave widening or promotion permanently poised at REVIEW/MERGE_QUEUED with no legal fail-closed product transition. A future implementation could incorrectly infer success, retry, or cleanup authority.
findings.required_plan_correction: Enumerate mutually exclusive synchronized rollout rows for every reachable settled UNKNOWN disposition. Only E06/E17 verified application may advance bounds or cross MERGED. All accepted-risk, declared-failed, compensation, and verification-failure outcomes must take explicit abort/rollback/failure paths based on proved exposure, with later single-owner cleanup.

findings.title: IR06 permits the rollout coordinate to resume canary while control health is still degraded or failed
findings.requirement: PLAN §8.4 states that degraded or failed control cannot admit, widen, promote, or resume canary. The normative row must enforce that rule, not rely on canonical projection masking.
evidence: IR06 guards CANARY_PAUSED->CANARY_RUNNING only with continuity proof and unchanged bounds; it does not require control_health_state=HEALTHY or a completed IH03 transition.
Reducer priority 15 maps TELEMETRY_DEGRADED, CONTROL_PAUSED, or CONTROL_FAILED to BLOCKED, but it still accepts the rollout coordinate mutation unless a reachability invariant rejects it.
The reachability invariants require HEALTHY for PROMOTING/PROMOTED/OBSERVING, but do not forbid CANARY_RUNNING with degraded/failed control.
IR31 and other CANARY_RUNNING receipt rows do not add a HEALTHY guard, so a component state hidden behind canonical BLOCKED can continue consuming exposure-related receipts.
reproduction: Present a continuity proof to IR06 without first applying IH03. The exact IR06 guard passes and changes rollout_state to CANARY_RUNNING, while the reducer remains canonically BLOCKED.
The product now records canary running under paused control, contrary to PLAN §8.4, and no manifest invariant rejects the tuple.
findings.impact: Canonical masking is not an authorization barrier. A literal implementation can resume or process canary activity before control health is restored, violating a core safety requirement.
findings.required_plan_correction: Require control_health_state=HEALTHY and the durable IH03 restoration/fresh-decision facts on IR06 and every exposure/resume row, and reject CANARY_RUNNING paired with degraded/paused/failed control as an impossible tuple. Add both event orders to the interleaving witnesses.

Fresh immutable evidence retrieval and same-run human semantic review remain future gates and were not treated as closure failures.
